game.name: Resonance Of Fate (USA, Europe)(En,Ja,Fr,De,Es,It)
game.desc: In the distant future, humanity is threatened with extinction because the Earth is polluted. The survivors turn to Basel, an immense machine programmed to preserve the environment, and leave it in charge of managing the life and death cycles of the planet and its inhabitants. The curtain is about to open on the group of mercenaries you play. Their fate, intertwined with that of unstoppable machines and a mysterious caste of oligarchs, now depends solely on you. Experience an exciting story whose conclusion will seal the fate of humanity. Let yourself be captivated by a unique combat system offering thrilling strategic confrontations, and by magnificent musical compositions.
